home.summary: Shows only the active services authorized for the current family or the relevant access and onboarding states.
home.purpose: Uses KinHub bootstrap and a server-side catalog to avoid hardcoded cards or family data stored in the browser.
home.actions: Sign in from the global shell, create the first family, reload the catalog, or open an authorized service.
home.prerequisites: A valid session, network connectivity, and a family with service availability are required to see services.
home.fields: The page distinguishes visitor, onboarding, catalog loading, empty, offline, session expired, access denied, and recoverable error states.
home.limits: Release Notes stays outside the catalog and no availability or localization is saved offline.

kinlist.summary: Checks bootstrap, active family, and KinList availability before showing the protected /kinlist route content.
kinlist.purpose: Prevents the direct URL or the Home card from becoming proof of service authorization.
kinlist.actions: Wait for the check, create the first family if missing, retry after a recoverable error, or sign in again when the session expired.
kinlist.prerequisites: A valid API token and an active connection are required for both bootstrap and the server-side access check.
kinlist.fields: The page distinguishes loading, onboarding, expired session, denied access, technical failure, the offline shell, and a form with only the 1-100 character family name field.
kinlist.limits: KinList content is not mounted before the access check and no authorization is stored in the browser.

about.summary: Check the version and build metadata.
about.purpose: Helps identify the exact app instance in use.
about.actions: Read version, commit and date, or open release notes.
about.fields: SemVer version, commit, build date, and environment.
about.limits: Local values may display the local marker.

releaseNotes.purpose: Makes features, fixes, and breaking changes visible.
releaseNotes.actions: Review history, categories, and related links.
releaseNotes.prerequisites: A connection is needed to check a newly published version.
releaseNotes.fields: Version, date, area, category, and breaking indicator.
releaseNotes.limits: The PWA cache may require a controlled refresh.

settings.purpose: Stores experience preferences on this device.
settings.actions: Change language or theme, or restart the tutorial.
settings.prerequisites: The browser must allow local storage.
settings.limits: Preferences are not yet synchronized across devices.

notFound.summary: Explains why a page is unavailable.
notFound.purpose: Provides recovery from an incorrect address.
notFound.actions: Return home or use the navigation.
notFound.limits: Check the address when following an external link.

docs.summary: Read the complete guide linked from each page.
docs.purpose: Displays localized Markdown documentation in the product.
docs.actions: Read the guide and return to the related feature.
docs.prerequisites: The guide must exist in the selected language.
docs.limits: Guides are refreshed during the build.

error.summary: Provides safe recovery from an unexpected error.
error.purpose: Avoids a blank screen and keeps an exit path available.
error.limits: If the error continues, note the version and commit.
